change: Breakdown Register switched from a 14-column table (needed horizontal sliding to see anything past Location) to a card layout, matching the approved demo. Each breakdown is now a card: Truck No + Date/Location + Status badge at top, Issue text, a 2-column detail grid (Contact, Mechanic, ETD, Work Done, plus Delay Reason/Spares Sent/Closing Remarks when present), and action buttons -- no horizontal scrolling needed at all, just scroll down. Search, filters, CSV export, and bulk WhatsApp share all still work exactly the same against the same underlying data.
